dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Pinky Promise was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on her behavior in a home environment. Pinky Promise has shown highly fearful behavior while at the care center; during intake and in her handling assessment she was very tense during handling, and during her medical exam she escalated to growling, head whipping, and snapping. Due to her high levels of fear, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Pinky Promise
